name: pgs-launch
description: The editable pgs launch film and presentation assets

scripts.audio: node scripts/score.mjs && ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -loglevel error -i out/score.wav -af volume=0.72 -c:a aac -b:a 192k public/score.m4a
scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts PgsLaunch out/pgs-launch.mp4 --codec h264 --pixel-format yuv420p --crf 18
scripts.social-video: remotion render src/index.ts PgsSocial out/pgs-social.mp4 --codec h264 --pixel-format yuv420p --crf 18
